description: Façade researchers publish model representations of a mechanically ventilated single-storey double-skin façade. The native description compares four building-energy simulation tools using an exhaust-air façade case, with built-in components or custom zonal representations assessed against experimental measurements. Zenodo lists one ZIP containing EnergyPlus, IDA ICE, IES and TRNSYS models, freely accessible under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is the reported façade test case; site, complete measurement periods and exact tool versions are not stated in the inspected metadata. The authors conclude that performance varies by output and caution against relying on these models alone for short-term dynamics or HVAC sizing. Related naturally ventilated and flexible façade models are distinct configurations; independent underlying observations are not asserted. No archive or measurements were opened, and the comparisons were not reproduced.
